Intro.Title: Hello, I'm Johans.
Intro.Text: I'm a fullstack software engineer with +5 years of experience. I enjoy building sites & apps. My focus is in JS/TS world.

About.Title: About me
About.Bio1: Fullstack Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience, focused on mission-critical systems: authentication, payments, and internal platforms for banking and fintech.
About.Bio2: I've led auth migrations and payment-gateway rollouts for 45,000+ active clients, and teams of up to 6 developers on integration projects during bank mergers.
About.Bio3: Outside that track, I've built analytics dashboards for brands like Diageo, Heineken, and Walmart US, and maintain a couple of open-source JavaScript/TypeScript libraries.
About.Bio4: I care about clean code and architecture decisions that hold up in production, not just in the demo. If you need someone to take a system from zero to stable, let's talk.

Projects.Title: My Projects
Projects.Renduo: SaaS that turns the React components a team already maintains into a PDF-generation API: invoices, reports, and contracts from any backend with a single HTTP call, no separate template language to keep in sync.
Projects.Revius: Lets users create and edit reviews about certain products on the internet, it also has the data of the reviews from other retailers websites. (Still in development)
Projects.Sorted Collections: Open-source library for JavaScript/TypeScript with SortedList, SortedSet, and SortedMap — zero runtime dependencies, inspired by Python's sortedcontainers.
Projects.Datoteca: TypeScript library for generating realistic and localized test data for Chile
Projects.Falta 1: PWA made with React and TypeScript, it allows users to create and search for sports events in their city, it also has a chat system and a notification system.

Full-Stack Developer.Description: I worked as a full-stack developer working at Evalueserve Chile. My stack includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Prisma and MongoDB.

Software Developer at Evalueserve Chile.Description: I worked as a full-stack developer on applications for clients like Diageo, Heineken, and Gates Ventures, focusing on data visualization and analytics dashboards for decision-making.

Senior Developer at Evalueserve Chile.Description: As a senior developer, I worked on full-stack applications for clients like Walmart US, Intuit India, and McDonald's US, integrating large amounts of data to build dashboards and advanced visualizations.

Senior Software Engineer | Tech Lead at.Title: Senior Software Engineer | Tech Lead at BICE Hipotecaria
Senior Software Engineer | Tech Lead at.Description: I started by building Carpeta Digital, an internal system for managing credit-related documents, and led the migration of the authentication system from on-premise Keycloak to Auth0 for over 15,000 clients. Later, as Tech Lead, I led a team of 6 developers on integration projects during the Bice and Security merger, including rolling out the Toku payment gateway for over 30,000 clients.
